Hi Samir / Ava —

Thanks again for the productive discovery call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep momentum: 

Summary from call:
- Primary goal: reduce inference latency for our patient-facing triage assistant while keeping per-token cost under target.
- Key constraints: SOC2 evidence for logs, VPC isolation for PHI, and predictable throughput during morning surge windows.
- Internal stakeholders: Samir (Product), Ava (Platform/Integrations), you mentioned wanting a VP/CTO intro to unblock procurement.

Proposed next steps:
1) Executive alignment (VP/CTO intro) — 30 min: overview of architecture, commitment model (Dedicated vs Private), and high-level SLOs.
2) Technical deep dive — 60 min: infra mapping, sample throughput tests, and integration checklist (KMS, audit logs).

Available windows I can offer this week:
- Wed 3/23: 9:00–10:00 AM PT (exec intro slot)
- Thu 3/24: 1:00–2:30 PM PT (technical deep dive)
- Fri 3/25: 11:00–11:30 AM PT (alternate exec intro)

If those don't work, please share two 30–60 minute windows that do and I will align Marcus (solutions engineering) and Naomi (security lead).

Attachments: RIF-Prod-Playbook.pdf (short product + infra notes), acme-security-questions.xlsx (placeholder for SOC2 items you asked about).

A few asks for the deep dive prep (helps us be efficient):
- List of current GPU types and cloud region(s) you plan to use (if known)
- Example request distribution (peak RPS and p50/p95 latency targets)
- Any specific compliance questions to include up front

Thanks — looking forward to getting your execs looped in.
